answer: Give every newcomer a plot in the shared verification garden. They lock a $75 deposit and take on 20 real pending tasks: dispute reviews, spam pruning, duplicate checks. Over 30 days they tend each task while three established gardeners audit every decision. Pass 18 of 20 and the plot becomes full entry; fail and the deposit burns and the season restarts. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs $75,000 in deposits plus 20,000 tasks at 15 minutes each, around 5,000 hours of real work. Every verified decision earns a violet stamp on a basalt-hard record. A garden only feeds the people who tend it.
